description: 29 deterministic synthetic job cases for regression/calibration.

cases.title: Research Assistant – Molecular Biology
cases.description: Molecular biology research assistant supporting PCR, qPCR, RNA extraction, Western blot and cell culture. Bachelor's degree in biology or related field. No prior full-time experience required.

cases.title: Laboratory Intern – Molecular Diagnostics
cases.description: Internship in molecular diagnostics. Perform PCR, qPCR, RNA isolation and basic laboratory procedures under supervision. Suitable for undergraduate students.

cases.title: Research Technician – Cell Biology
cases.description: Cell biology laboratory role involving cell culture, immunofluorescence, protein extraction and BCA assay. Bachelor's degree in biology or biotechnology. Entry-level candidates welcome.

cases.title: Molecular Biology Working Student
cases.description: Working student position in molecular biology. Support PCR, qPCR, RNA extraction and laboratory experiments. Enrolled bachelor's student accepted. No years of experience required.

cases.title: Bioinformatics Working Student
cases.description: Working student role in bioinformatics and genomics. Analyze NGS and RNA-seq data using Python and R. Experience with gene expression and differential expression analysis is beneficial. Bachelor's students are welcome.

cases.title: Research Assistant – Computational Biology
cases.description: Computational biology research assistant working on NGS, transcriptomics, TCGA and gene expression analysis. Python, R and Linux required. Master's degree preferred; bachelor's degree in a related field considered.

cases.title: Genomics Data Analyst Intern
cases.description: Internship focused on genomics data analysis, transcriptomics and NGS. Tasks include TCGA/GTEx analysis, survival analysis and immune-infiltration analysis using R and Python.

cases.title: Bioinformatician – Microbial Genomics
cases.description: Bioinformatics role supporting microbial genomics, NGS pipelines, Python, R and Linux. Bachelor's or master's degree in bioinformatics, computational biology or a related discipline.

cases.title: Drug Discovery Intern
cases.description: Internship in drug discovery and computational drug design. Use AutoDock Vina, molecular docking, SwissADME and protein structures. Suitable for biology or related undergraduate students with relevant project experience.

cases.title: Computational Drug Design Working Student
cases.description: Working student position involving molecular docking, AutoDock Vina, ADME and protein structure analysis. Undergraduate or master's students in biology, biotechnology or computational chemistry can apply.

cases.title: Machine Learning Scientist
cases.description: Develop deep learning and representation learning models for user modeling and multimodal systems. Strong computer science and machine learning background required. No molecular biology, genomics or drug discovery work.

cases.title: Data Engineer – Cloud Platforms
cases.description: Build data pipelines using Python, SQL, Spark and AWS. Focus on cloud infrastructure, data warehousing and distributed systems. Computer science background preferred.

cases.title: Senior Scientist – Molecular Biology
cases.description: Senior Scientist leading molecular biology programs. PhD in molecular biology or related field required. Minimum 8 years of industry experience required.

cases.title: Principal Scientist – Genomics
cases.description: Principal Scientist role with team leadership. PhD required and 10+ years of experience in genomics and bioinformatics.

cases.title: PhD Student – Cancer Genomics
cases.description: Funded PhD student position in cancer genomics using NGS and transcriptomics. Applicants must enroll in a doctoral program.

cases.title: Research Associate – Molecular Biology
cases.description: Research associate position in molecular biology. PhD required. Five years of relevant experience required.

cases.title: Bioinformatics Scientist
cases.description: Bioinformatics scientist role. 5+ years of professional bioinformatics experience required. Python, R and NGS expertise expected.

cases.title: Research Assistant – Molecular Biology
cases.description: Research assistant in molecular biology, PCR and cell culture. Master's or PhD is preferred but not required. Bachelor's degree accepted. No mandatory experience requirement.

cases.title: Bioinformatics Intern
cases.description: Internship for undergraduate students in bioinformatics. NGS, Python and R are useful. PhD is preferred but not required.

cases.title: Molecular Biology Assistant
cases.description: Entry-level molecular biology assistant. Bachelor's degree required. Previous laboratory experience is preferred, not required.

cases.title: Full-Time Research Assistant – Genomics
cases.description: Full-time research assistant working on genomics and NGS. Bachelor's degree accepted. Work schedule is Monday to Friday, full time. No requirement for current class attendance.

cases.title: Working Student – Bioinformatics
cases.description: Working student role, 15–20 hours per week during semester, with flexible hours. Bioinformatics, Python and R experience required. Undergraduate enrollment required.

cases.title: Intern – Computational Biology
cases.description: Three-month full-time internship in computational biology and genomics. Python and NGS experience required. Students are welcome to apply.

cases.title: Moleküler Biyoloji Araştırma Asistanı
cases.description: Moleküler biyoloji laboratuvarında PCR, qPCR ve RNA ekstraksiyonu çalışmaları. Lisans mezunu veya son sınıf öğrencisi. Deneyim tercih sebebidir, zorunlu değildir.

cases.title: Biyoinformatik Stajyeri
cases.description: Biyoinformatik ve genomik stajı. Python, R, NGS ve gen ekspresyon analizi. Lisans öğrencileri başvurabilir. Doktora tercih sebebidir, zorunlu değildir.

cases.title: Kıdemli Biyolog
cases.description: Kıdemli biyolog. Laboratuvar ekibine liderlik, PCR ve hücre kültürü. En az 7 yıl deneyim ve yüksek lisans şartı.

cases.title: Application Scientist – Clinical Genomics
cases.description: Application Scientist supporting clinical genomics customers. NGS and genomics knowledge required, with customer-facing technical support. Bachelor's or master's in life sciences. International travel may be required.

cases.title: Laboratory Data Analyst
cases.description: Analyze laboratory datasets and quality-control metrics using Python and R. Work with molecular biology teams; prior laboratory experience is helpful but not required.

cases.title: Drug Discovery Research Assistant
cases.description: Support drug discovery projects, molecular docking and ADME analysis. AutoDock Vina and SwissADME are used. Bachelor's degree in biology or related field accepted.
